C-STATS-READOUT.IntentSummary: Implement the approved C-STATS-READOUT spec against the post-C-UPDATER-REVIEW-FIXES baseline: the keyed GET /stats readout route on the mark-stats-gateway worker, the shared tables.mjs (renderer, SQL constant, normalization), the query.mjs --remote mode with a main guard, the README "Readout access" section with the full revision sweep, the .gitignore hardening, and the M-071/V-M-071 graph and verification amendments — with the counting routes byte-identical and every gate green. Execution discipline: T-003 and T-004 are logically independent but touch files the same suite spawns (the dry-mode test runs node query.mjs), so the executor runs them serially — single-writer, no interleaving.

T-001.Title: Gitignore hardening first (the spec's earliest edit)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: .gitignore gains tools/stats-gateway/.dev.vars and tools/stats-gateway/.wrangler/ (the wrangler-dev convention paths can never be staged by a routine git add), and the committed dangling merge-conflict marker at line 87 is removed in the same edit; nothing else in the file changes.

Verification.Command: git check-ignore tools/stats-gateway/.dev.vars && git check-ignore tools/stats-gateway/.wrangler/ && ! grep -n ">>>>>>>" .gitignore

T-002.Title: tables.mjs — the single renderer, SQL constant and normalization module

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: New governed side-effect-free module tools/stats-gateway/tables.mjs exports renderTables (created here verbatim from query.mjs's implementation; the removal of query.mjs's local copies belongs to T-004), the 90-day GROUP BY SQL text as one named constant SQL_TEXT (the post-sibling index1 form — select blob1/index1/blob2/blob3 with SUM(_sample_interval), the 90-day window, the same GROUP BY and ORDER BY as query.mjs --live), and the upstream-JSON-to-rows normalization as a named export normalizeRows (String/Number coercion of day/event/dim/extra/count; a missing data array yields empty rows — the query.mjs precedent). Pure functions only: no top-level I/O, no CLI, importable by both the Workers bundler and Node. Carries a governed MODULE_CONTRACT/MODULE_MAP header (M-071, ROLE SCRIPT, MAP_MODE LOCALS) with VERSION 1.0.0, a CHANGE_SUMMARY entry for this change, and LINKS to .grace/graph/features.xml and .grace/verification/features.xml and C-STATS-READOUT.

Verification.Command: node --input-type=module -e "import('./tools/stats-gateway/tables.mjs').then(m => { if (typeof m.renderTables !== 'function' || typeof m.SQL_TEXT !== 'string' || typeof m.normalizeRows !== 'function') process.exit(1); const t = m.renderTables([]); if (!('byDay' in t && 'fromBreakdown' in t)) process.exit(1); if (m.normalizeRows({data:[]}).length !== 0) process.exit(1); })"

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The router gains the exact /stats pathname branch; the handler enforces, in order: route shape (non-empty searchParams is a 404 with Cache-Control: no-store), auth (the x-read-key header exact-matched or constant-time-compared against STATS_READ_KEY — the constant-time variant, if adopted, is the portable pre-hash form: SHA-256 digest both sides, then compare, so the code runs identically in Node tests and the Workers runtime with no crypto.subtle.timingSafeEqual dependency; the executor wraps the ENTIRE auth step (the pre-hash digest included, not only the comparison) so any error path maps to the bodyless 401 — never a platform error page; unset or empty secret fails closed; every comparison error path, including a length-mismatch throw, maps to the same bodyless 401 with no-store; no-store is never added to the shared notFound constructor), upstream-secret presence (unset or empty STATS_API_TOKEN/STATS_ACCOUNT_ID yields the fixed 502 regardless of cache state), the 60-second module-scope cache (opens on landed success; holds mapped rows only), then one upstream fetch to the SQL API endpoint built from env.STATS_ACCOUNT_ID with Bearer env.STATS_API_TOKEN, aborted at 10 seconds VIA A SETTIMEOUT-DRIVEN controller.abort (the injection seam for T-005's fake-timer test — AbortSignal.timeout is NOT fake-timer-advanceable, proven by probe), judged by res.ok and JSON parsing alone (no response-header reads). Responses: 200 application/json Cache-Control no-store with { byDay, fromBreakdown } via tables.mjs; bodyless 401; 502 with exactly {"error":"stats-upstream"} (application/json, no-store). The branch writes zero datapoints on every path and logs nothing (the spec's "at most one" marker resolves to ZERO: the readout branch emits no log output at all, so V-M-071's Markers inventory and TraceAssertion sentence stay unchanged); the branch is delimited in the source by begin/end comment markers (// --- C-STATS-READOUT readout branch --- / // --- end readout branch ---) enclosing the ENTIRE readout handler and the cache variable (the router dispatch line is covered by the route-shape pins instead), markers that the no-logging scan slices between. The governed header is amended per the spec's R-8: PURPOSE/SCOPE rewordings (including the datapoint clause "one per valid counting request — the readout route writes none", the SCOPE middle 404 sentence scoped to counting routes, and the closing body-sentence exception), MODULE_MAP gains the readout locals, STATUS carries the custom-domain form, LINKS reference C-STATS-READOUT (with the archive-exception note) — surviving any stale reference the sibling's landing left — and the file's VERSION is bumped with a CHANGE_SUMMARY entry for this change. handleFeed/handlePkg/OS_TABLE/PLATFORM_TABLE semantics untouched. THE SINGLE SANCTIONED SCAN AMENDMENT LANDS IN THIS TASK: the /headers\.get\(/ source-scan ban in tests/tools/stats-gateway.test.mjs grows the one x-read-key allowlist — matching the exact read expression request.headers.get('x-read-key'), never a line or substring filter — in the same commit as the read it permits, so the suite is green the moment this task's verification runs (not deferred to T-005).

T-004.Title: query.mjs — --remote mode and the main guard

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: query.mjs imports renderTables, the SQL constant and the normalization from tables.mjs (its local copies removed); the CLI switch moves behind a main guard (importing the module executes nothing); a new --remote mode reads STATS_READ_KEY (absent or empty fails with an actionable error naming the variable), GETs the gateway /stats with the X-Read-Key header, and prints the same tables from the JSON; a non-2XX answer prints the status and the fixed body only and exits nonzero (never-echo-more governs non-fixed bodies; a 2XX answer with invalid JSON fails with a fixed error and nonzero exit; a transport rejection exits nonzero with no secret material in the default output). --dry and --live are unchanged in behavior (live keeps reading CF_API_TOKEN with CF_ACCOUNT_ID); the usage line lists --dry, --live, --remote. The governed header is amended: PURPOSE and DEPENDS corrected to name both live-mode variables, --remote and the shared module (tables.mjs in DEPENDS), MODULE_MAP documents the new mode and is deduplicated, LINKS corrected (features.xml; C-STATS-READOUT with the archive-exception note), and the file's VERSION is bumped with a CHANGE_SUMMARY entry for this change.
